picks.headline: The AI Panic Is Forcing Developers To Prove Their Trailers Were Made By Humans
picks.excerpt: Humankind 2's big announcement trailer was called AI slop by many online, but behind-the-scenes footage shows real animals, people, and sets
picks.rationale: Proof-of-human is becoming a shipping requirement — teams now need BTS capture planned into the trailer budget, not added after the backlash.

picks.headline: Hands-on with DLSS 5 in NBA 2K27: what works and what doesn't about Nvidia's new AI upscaler
picks.excerpt: I put my apprehensions to the side to give DLSS 5 a fair shot. Here's what I found
picks.rationale: First real hands-on verdict on the shipped build — a different angle from the launch note and the perf-cost numbers already covered: where the neural filter actually holds up.

picks.headline: Modder Enables DLSS 5 Neural Rendering On AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT
picks.excerpt: DLSS 5 Neural Rendering now works on AMD RX 9070 XT, boosting FPS in Cyberpunk 2077 and GTA V: Enhanced, with mod improving performance by 12%
picks.rationale: Nvidia's vendor lock on neural rendering just cracked in the wild — changes who can even test the look, and what art direction has to plan for.

picks.headline: Building a Procedural Shell Grotto with Substance 3D Designer & UE5
picks.excerpt: Coraline Lyu spoke about the creation process behind the Shell Grotto project, explaining how she aimed to capture the identity of the Shell Grotto in England, how she built two separate node-based systems, and detailing how she assembled the ornamental wall patterns.
picks.rationale: A concrete two-system node breakdown for ornamental pattern assembly — procedural craft a designer can copy into a Substance/UE pipeline tomorrow.

picks.headline: 24% Of Gamescom Reveals Officially Used AI
picks.excerpt: 23.64% of the games featured during Gamescom ONL this year used AI in some form.
picks.rationale: A hard, citable disclosure number for the year's biggest showcase — the baseline anyone arguing about AI adoption in games now has to work from.
